en.text: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. us, again.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你丢弃了我们，使我们破败；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你丟棄了我們，使我們破敗；

en.text: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. its fractures, for it quakes.
You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth.

zhSimplified.text: 你把旌旗赐给敬畏你的人，

zhTraditional.text: 你把旌旗賜給敬畏你的人，

en.text: So that your beloved may be delivered, with your right hand, and answer us.

zhSimplified.text: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，

zhTraditional.text: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們，

en.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

zhSimplified.text: 神已经指着他的圣洁说：我要欢乐； ，丈量。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝已經指着他的聖潔說：我要歡樂； ，丈量。

en.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. is the defense of my head. is my scepter.

zhSimplified.text: 是我的，也是我的。 是护卫我头的； 是我的杖。

zhTraditional.text: 是我的，也是我的。 是護衛我頭的； 是我的杖。

en.text: Moab is my wash basin. my sandal on Edom. in triumph over Philistia.”

zhSimplified.text: 是我的沐浴盆； 抛鞋。 啊，你还能因我欢呼吗？

zhTraditional.text: 是我的沐浴盆； 拋鞋。 啊，你還能因我歡呼嗎？

en.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

zhSimplified.text: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 地？

zhTraditional.text: 誰能領我進堅固城？ 地？

en.text: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？

en.text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

zhSimplified.text: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，

zhTraditional.text: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人，

en.text: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

zhSimplified.text: 我们倚靠 神才得施展大能，

zhTraditional.text: 我們倚靠上帝才得施展大能，
